title: Twisting polygon tower
summary: A regular polygon floor plate is repeated up a tower, each floor rotated a fixed share of a total twist, and the floors are lofted into a twisting mass - the simplest parametric tower.
how_to_use: 'Plate radius' and 'Plate sides' set the floor plate; 'Floors' the number of levels; 'Floor height' the spacing.
'Total twist' is the rotation in degrees from bottom to top.
Bake the final Geometry parameter to get the tower surface.
concepts: Division: spreading a total value over a count

steps.title: 1  INPUTS - change these
steps.explain: Floor plate size and number of sides, number of floors, floor height and total twist.

steps.title: 2  Floor plate at the base
steps.explain: A point at the origin is used as the base plane and Polygon draws the floor plate on it.

steps.title: 3  Height and twist per floor
steps.explain: Total twist / Floors gives the rotation step and a Series turns it into one angle per floor (Radians converts it). A second Series gives each floor its height. Rotate turns the plate and Move lifts it to its level.

steps.title: 4  RESULT - loft the floors
steps.explain: Loft skins the rotated floor plates into the tower surface; the Geometry parameter is the result to bake.
